delta.insert: The water passage opened into a vast chamber. Crystals hung from the ceiling like chandeliers, their aquamarine light reflecting off a lake so still it was indistinguishable from a mirror. At the center of the lake, rising from the water on a pillar of solid crystal, stood a figure.
It was humanoid but not human—its body was composed entirely of translucent crystal facets that shifted and reformed with each breath-like movement.
Where its face should have been, a constellation of smaller crystals rotated slowly, and when it spoke, the voice came not from a mouth but from every crystal in the chamber resonating at once.
"You have walked the water path, child of flesh." The voice was neither male nor female, warm nor cold. It simply
. "Few choose the element they fear most. This speaks well of you."
Kira's throat tightened. "How do you know what I fear?"
"The labyrinth knows all who walk within it. It knew you before you were born, Kira Valdris, daughter of Elara, apprentice to the cartographer.
It has been waiting for you since the Shattered Crown fell."
